regime.detail: Stocks are falling while Treasury yields fall, so money is moving into bonds.

read: The S&P 500 fell 0.2% on Wednesday, Nov 25 and fell 1.9% over the past week. The VIX closed at 26.8.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 22 bp to 4.85%, oil rose 2.0%, gold fell 2.5%, the dollar fell 0.1%, and chip stocks fell 8.1%.
Strongest sector this week: Materials (+1.5%). Weakest: Semiconductors (−8.1%).
The biggest news themes right now: Trade, tariffs & China, Inflation, jobs & economy, AI & chips.
